subject: Re: Kickoff: COLA audio embeddings as a platform backbone
body:
Hi Dmitri,

Staffing: Vera Egede leads at 50%, Leilani Nakamura 40% on the serving/platform side, Wei Ivanov 30% on eval design, Halima Toure 20% for the TFDS input pipelines.

Compute is light — titan-a100 best-effort, 16 GPUs for SSL pre-training runs; COLA is deliberately a simple contrastive setup, no giant batches needed.

Scheduling constraint that shapes everything: the Corpus v2 migration freeze lands on 2026-06-26, so our audio ingestion and any new dataset registrations have to be on v2 before that date. I've sequenced Halima's pipeline work first so we're not registering datasets against a frozen system in July, and the platform integration decision needs to happen by mid-June for the same reason.

Deshawn
